Subject: Charter & Decision Owners — Blue Horizon MAP Kickoff

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier this week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on success criteria, decision owners, and a realistic timeline to pilot and close. I copied Marissa (AE) who will lead the commercial side and help keep the plan current.

Quick summary of what we'd like to lock in with you this week:
- Top goals for a pilot (what success looks like)
- Primary decision owner and procurement contacts
- Key technical stakeholders (security/compliance, data science) and who owns access
- Target timeline for pilot start and PO/contract decision (your target quarter)

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm goals & owners (reply below)
2) We share a one-sheet MAP + timeline (attachment)
3) 30–45 min kickoff workshop to align roles and immediate tasks

Suggested kickoff times (PDT): Tue 4/26 9:30–10:15, Wed 4/27 11:00–11:45. Let me know what works or propose two slots.

Attachment: proposed-timeline.pdf (one-page timeline stub)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Charter & Decision Owners — Blue Horizon MAP Kickoff

Jonas —

Thanks, and happy to drive this from our side. I'm the project champion for data access and the pilot. Quick answers to your bullet list below: 

- Pilot goals: 1) Reduce triage time for clinical notes by 40% in our pilot clinics; 2) Surface high-confidence summarization for provider workflows.
- Decision owner: Rajiv Mehta (VP of Product) — he owns the procurement sign-off. I'll loop him in when we have the pilot plan.
- Technical stakeholders: Samir (IT/security) will evaluate the data flows and enclave requirements; Elena (Data Science) will own model evaluation and hold the evaluation dataset.
- Target timeline: We are aiming to kick off pilot in mid-May and come to a contract decision by end of June (that aligns with our Q3 planning).

I can do Tue 4/26 9:30 PDT for the kickoff workshop. Please include your MAP template and any pre-work for Samir/Elena so they can review ahead of the meeting.

Aisha Patel
Director, Clinical Innovation | Blue Horizon Health
aisha.patel@bluehorizonhealth.com | (617) 555-6310

Thanks, Aisha & team. Per our commitments, I've filled out the initial MAP worksheet with proposed milestones and owners — see attached BH_MAP_v1.0.xlsx. Key highlights:

- Pilot scope: 3 clinics (de-identified notes), 4-week pilot window, evaluation metrics (triage-time reduction, summarization accuracy against human labels)
- Commercial timeline: PO target by 2027-06-30, with a pilot acceptance milestone in June to trigger procurement conversation
- Owners
  - Project champion: Aisha Patel (Blue Horizon)
  - Decision owner: Rajiv Mehta (Blue Horizon)
  - Security owner: Samir Rao (Blue Horizon)
  - Pilot enablement / CS: Dylan Brooks (Redwood)
  - Contract/commercial: Marissa Cole (Redwood)

Immediate asks before the kickoff:
1) Samir — can you confirm preferred method for data transfer (SFTP, secure GCS bucket, or on-prem enclave) and any additional org-level controls we should list on the security checklist?
2) Elena — will you be able to provide a small evaluation slice (approx. 500 notes) by 5/10 so we can run an initial baseline?
3) Rajiv — if you want procurement to see an early cost estimate, we can have a draft by 5/5 once we confirm pilot size.

I've attached the MAP (BH_MAP_v1.0.xlsx) and added comments in the Drive doc. I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 4/26 9:30 PDT shortly.
